name: zclass_cls_di_filter_regions_against_sphere
description: zClass_cls_di::FilterRegionsAgainstSphere initializes filter-region state, scans overlapping world grid cells, recurses world children, and returns whether any region hits were appended.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this grid-region helper; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zClass DI/source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x446a80 validates the fastcall world/center ABI, stack arguments for nodeNamePrefix/radius/enableDistanceCull/requireLineOfSight/outHitList, null world/class-data error returns, queued tree update, hit-list reset, grid-coordinate calls for sphere bounds, global FilterRegions state setup, inclusive row/column scan, area child filtering, world listB fallback recursion, and final no-hit return.
The native smoke verifies a one-cell world scan appends the expected filter hit through the public function and preserves the accepted hit fields.
